q: Shubho ate four pieces of Hilsha fish at dinner. The passive form of the sentence is
o: Four pieces of Hilsha fish at dinner were ate by Shubho
At dinner four pieces of Hilsha fish Shubho ate
Four pieces of Hilsha fish were eating by Shubho at dinner
Four pieces of Hilsha fish at dinner were eaten by Shubho
e: Past Indefinite active-এর passive-এ was/were + V3 বসে। Four pieces বহুবচন, তাই were eaten: Four pieces of Hilsha fish at dinner were eaten by Shubho। অর্থ: শুভ রাতের খাবারে চার টুকরো ইলিশ খেয়েছিল। প্রথম অপশনে ate (V2) ভুল, তৃতীয়টিতে eating ভুল রূপ। eat-এর রূপ: eat, ate, eaten।
